title: dk_connectome plugin manifest
description: Schema for plugins/<name>/plugin.yaml. Validated by plugins/loader.smk after YAML load.

name.description: Plugin identifier. Must match the parent directory name.

version.description: Semver of this plugin (independent of the workflow version).

kind.description: `stage` = produces pipeline outputs; `internal` = shared helpers only.

order.description: Load order among stages (lower = earlier). Internal plugins always load first.

rules.description: Rules file relative to the plugin directory.

provides.description: Symbolic outputs (helper-function names) this plugin makes available to downstream plugins.

containers.description: Keys under config.containers whose .sif files must exist.

config.description: Dotted config keys that must be set and non-empty.

plugins.description: Upstream plugin names that must also be enabled.

optional.description: Same shape as `requires`; loader emits an info note rather than an error.

options.description: Plugin-specific config knobs (documentation only; loader does not type-check values).

resources.description: Default resource request; overridable via top-level config.threads / config.resources.

config_schema.description: Free-form config doc (internal plugin only). Loader does not enforce.

then.description: Stages must declare a load order.
